name: minute_utc
description: UTC minute bucket start timestamp written by the request-path gateway.

name: runtime_pool_id
description: Merged FCFS runtime capacity pool bucket identifier.

name: risk_tier
description: Risk tolerance tier (RL-1 through RL-5) resolved at admission.

name: window_sec
description: Sub-minute enforcement window duration in seconds (1, 10, 30, or 60).

name: weighted_burndown_units
description: Observed weighted token burndown units consumed in the window.

name: committed_capacity_units
description: Provisioned capacity units available in the runtime pool for the window.

name: peak_burst_ratio
description: Peak sub-minute demand-to-committed ratio observed inside the minute.

name: pt_requests
description: Upstream attempts served on Provisioned Throughput.

name: priority_spillover_requests
description: Upstream attempts spilling over to Priority PayGo.

name: standard_spillover_requests
description: Upstream attempts served on Standard or Flex PayGo.

name: involuntary_spillover_requests
description: Spillover attempts occurring while caller stayed within funded pool share.

name: http_429_count
description: HTTP 429 responses observed across upstream legs in the minute.

name: gateway_failover_count
description: Healthy single-call upstream failover legs (attempt_index > 1) executed by the gateway.

name: caller_retry_count
description: Caller-side SDK retry storm attempts detected after HTTP 429.
